verdict.rationale: The pack documents skills that run tests and QA on the user's own code (/ship runs tests, /qa re-verifies fixes, /plan-eng-review locks in tests). Nothing shows gstack maintaining tests or evals for its own skills to catch regressions. The CONTRIBUTING excerpts cover only a dev-mode symlink workflow and the session-learnings log, neither of which is a regression test or eval suite for skill changes.
